description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human<br><br></strong>Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.<br><br>This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.</p></div><p><strong>About the Team &amp; Impact</strong> <br>At Okta, Demo Engineering bridges the gap between product innovation and go-to-market execution—acting as a global force multiplier for our technical sales organization. We equip internal and partner Solution Engineers worldwide with the tools and environments needed to effortlessly demonstrate how Okta secures identities across workforces, customers, and AI agents.</p> <p>In this role, your code directly powers Okta’s global sales engine. The demo architectures and interactive experiences you create will be leveraged by hundreds of field engineers across dozens of countries, influencing thousands of enterprise customer conversations. Operating within an engineering-first, collaborative culture focused on automation, modularity, and self-service, you will build the core platform that makes Okta’s field teams faster, sharper, and more scalable.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Architect Reusable Assets:</strong> Design and develop modular demo components and pre-configured product environments tailored to high-impact, solution-driven customer scenarios.</li> <li><strong>Capture Field Insights:</strong> Partner closely with global field teams to gather "Voice of the Customer" feedback—translating prospect expectations, preferences, and friction points into platform improvements.</li> <li><strong>Drive Platform Adoption:</strong> Team up with Field Readiness to champion the Demo Platform and accelerate usage across the broader go-to-market organization.</li> <li><strong>Measure &amp; Optimize:</strong> Build telemetry, analytics, and reporting dashboards to monitor demo engagement and quantify field impact.</li> <li><strong>Launch New Capabilities:</strong> Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management and Core Engineering to build demo-ready experiences ahead of new product releases.</li> <li><strong>Influence Product Roadmap:</strong> Represent field and customer insights during release planning to help shape future product direction.</li> <li><strong>Enable the Field:</strong> Author clear technical walkthroughs, demonstration guides, and video tutorials to empower self-service adoption.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring to the Table</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li><strong>Industry Experience:</strong> 5+ years of hands-on software development experience building Enterprise SaaS solutions.</li> <li><strong>Full-Stack &amp; Cloud Expertise:</strong> Strong proficiency in <strong>React.js</strong>, <strong>Node.js</strong>, and <strong>AWS Serverless</strong> architectures (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS).</li> <li><strong>Multi-Tenant Architecture:</strong> Proven background designing and implementing multi-tenant systems with strict tenant isolation.</li> <li><strong>DevOps &amp; Automation:</strong> Practical experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) or automated configuration management tools.</li> <li><strong>Identity &amp; API Fluency:</strong> Solid experience integrating REST/GraphQL APIs with identity providers, backed by strong working knowledge of modern authentication and authorization standards (<strong>OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML</strong>).</li> </ul> <p><strong>How You Work</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Globally Minded:</strong> Experienced in collaborating across time zones and supporting a distributed, international field organization.</li> <li><strong>Proactive Builder:</strong> Self-driven and resourceful—you spot gaps, propose solutions, and execute without needing micromanagement.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Connector:</strong> Energized by working at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Systems Thinker:</strong> Capable of balancing fast-turnaround field requests with long-term architectural scalability and code reuse.</li> <li><strong>Customer-Obsessed:</strong> Skilled at distilling qualitative customer and field feedback into concrete technical requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience on a Demo Engineering, Technical Marketing, or Developer Relations team.</li> <li>Background in Presales, Solutions Engineering, or Customer-Facing Technical Consulting.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with <strong>Okta</strong> or <strong>Auth0</strong> platforms.</li> </ul> <p>P19685_3616876</p> <p>#LI-Onsite</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>The Okta Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><a href="http://rewards.okta.com">Supporting Your Well-Being</a>&nbsp;</li> <li><a href="https://www.okta.com/company/okta-for-good/">Driving Social Impact&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.okta.com/company/talent-connection-community/">Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community</a></li> </ul> <p>We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.<br><br>Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws.<br><br>If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete any part of the job application, interview process, or onboarding please&nbsp;<a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1EfiEYZrIyhA2X4Fijk0R3RKYOzNoS3wtvyM4nhbZnXE/edit">use this Form</a> to request an accommodation.<br><br>Notice for New York City Applicants &amp; Employees: Okta may use Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT), as defined by New York City Local Law 144, that use artificial intelligence, machine learning, or other automated processes to assist in our recruitment and hiring process. In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, if you are an applicant or employee residing in New York City, please&nbsp;<a href="https://talent.okta.com/new-york-city-aedt-notice.html">click here</a> to view our full NYC AEDT Notice.</p></div>

<p class="p1"><span class="s1"><strong>Location : Pune<br>About Team &amp; About Role:</strong></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.</p> <p>You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup &amp; management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.</p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div status.</li> </ul> <div><br><strong>Requirements</strong><br><br><strong>Must-have</strong></div> <ul> <li>Strong hands-on programming skills in <strong>Golang</strong>.</li> <li>Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: <strong>OIDC/OAuth 2.0</strong> and <strong>SAML 2.0</strong> — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.</li> <li>Working knowledge of<strong> Active Directory</strong>.</li> <li>Applied cryptography/PKI experience: <strong>X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS</strong>.</li> <li>Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.</li> <li>Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.</li> <li>Simple, effective written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Nice-to-have</strong></div> <ul> class="content-conclusion"><h2>Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation</h2> <p>Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.</p> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rubrik-inc/mycompany/verification/">Linkedin</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/rubrikinc">X (formerly Twitter)</a> | <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rubrikinc/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.rubrik.com">Rubrik.com</a></p> <h2>Inclusion @ Rubrik</h2> <p>At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.</p> <p>Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.</p> <h3>Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:</h3> <ul> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.</p> </li> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled</h2> <p>Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.</p> <p>Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact&nbsp;<a href="mailto:hr@rubrik.com" target="_blank">hr@rubrik.com</a>. Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf" target="_blank">EEO IS THE LAW</a></p> <p><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/olms/regs/compliance/eo_posters/employeerightsposter2page_19final.pdf" target="_blank">NOTIFICATION OF EMPLOYEE RIGHTS UNDER FEDERAL LABOR LAWS</a></p></div>

About the role We're hiring two backend-heavy full-stack engineers (SDE 2 or SDE 3) for the Cowork team at Sarvam. Cowork is the agentic side of Indus: users hand it real work, and an agent plans, uses tools and connectors, works in a cloud sandbox, and hands back files, docs and artifacts across web, Android, iOS, macOS and Windows. The role is full stack, but the centre of gravity is the backend: the BFF that every client talks to, and increasingly the agent harness behind it. You'll ship features end to end, from the API and data model through to the client screens on mobile, desktop and web. What you'll work on Most of your time goes into the BFF and the services around it; the rest into client work and the harness, depending on what the roadmap needs that quarter. BFF (Chat Service): design and own the APIs that web, mobile and desktop share: sessions, conversations, streaming turns, artifacts, connectors, custom and managed agents. Data modelling, migrations, auth and RBAC, pagination and search. Real-time streaming: stream LLM output, tool calls and agent events from the harness to clients over an event bus, and keep it correct under reconnects, retries and partial failures. Agent harness and platform: contribute to Panja, our agent harness: tool and MCP integrations, sandboxed execution, file and artifact flows, latency and token-cost work. Clients: build features end to end on our Kotlin/Compose Multiplatform apps (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows) and the Next.js web app, so a feature you design in the backend reaches users on every surface. Production ownership: observability, on-call, RCAs, and making the system faster and cheaper with numbers to back it. Tech stack Python and PostgreSQL are the core; you don't need every item below on day one. Backend: Python, SQLAlchemy + Alembic, PostgreSQL, OpenAPI Supporting services: Go Mobile and desktop: Kotlin Multiplatform + Compose Multiplatform (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows) Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript What we're looking for A strong backend engineer who has also shipped real frontend work and is happy to keep doing both. 3+ years (SDE 2) or 5+ years (SDE 3) building and running production backend services. Deep in at least one backend language; Python preferred, Go, Kotlin/JVM or TypeScript/Node also welcome. Solid API and data-model design: REST/streaming APIs, PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, indexing, transactions. Distributed-systems fundamentals: async processing, queues or event streams, idempotency, retries, failure handling. Production experience on Kubernetes or a similar platform, with observability you actually used to debug an incident. Has shipped user-facing features on at least one client platform: Android, iOS, desktop or web (React/Next.js). Kotlin/Compose experience is a plus, not a gate. Willing to pick up the side of the stack they know less, and to learn agent and LLM systems on the job. Clear written communication: design docs, PR descriptions, RCAs. Nice to have Built on LLM APIs: tool calling, streaming, prompt caching, evals, or an agent loop of your own. MCP servers or clients, OAuth connector integrations, or sandboxed code execution. Kotlin Multiplatform / Compose Multiplatform, or native Android/iOS. Real-time systems: WebSockets/SSE, NATS, Kafka, or Temporal-style durable workflows. Go services, or performance and cost work with measurable before/after numbers. Open-source work or public writing we can read.

About Parspec Founded in 2021, Parspec is revolutionizing material procurement for the $13 trillion USD construction industry by digitizing and organizing the industry's product data. Our proprietary AI technology maintains a current and comprehensive catalogue of millions of products, enabling our customers to identify products that best meet their needs - instantly. Trusted by top designers, builders, distributors and sales agents and backed by leading venture investors, Parspec is paving the way for a more innovative, connected, and sustainable future in construction. Join us in building transformative technology that reshapes one of the world’s oldest and largest industries. The Opportunity We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Software Engineer to join Parspec's talented engineering team. In this pivotal role, you will blend backend system design expertise, coding proficiency, project leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring. As a Software Engineer, you will drive the delivery of innovative features while ensuring robustness, scalability, and seamless integration with Parspec's AI-powered platform. You will collaborate closely with Product, Frontend, and AI teams to transform feature ideas into reliable solutions, actively participating in the product lifecycle from estimation to production deployment and ongoing support. What You Will Achieve and Key Responsibilities Feature Development Design, develop, and maintain backend systems (including APIs and messaging solutions) to support new features while ensuring modular code design and maintainability. Performance Optimization Implement design patterns to create systems that deliver high performance with sub-second latency. System Scalability Build backend systems capable of scaling efficiently to meet increasing user demands. AI Inference Infrastructure Partner with the AI team to deploy, scale, and optimize model inference services in production, balancing latency, throughput, and cost across CPU and GPU workloads. Project Leadership Lead feature/project lifecycles from estimation to delivery by collaborating with cross-functional teams. System Design Architect and optimize distributed backend systems for low latency, high availability, and maintainability. Team Collaboration Act as the key point of coordination between Frontend, AI, and Backend teams to deliver cohesive features. Code Ownership Maintain high standards of code quality through reviews, modular design, and adherence to best practices. Infrastructure Management Deploy, maintain, and optimize backend services and infrastructure on AWS/GCP platforms. Testing & Debugging Ensure thorough testing of features while tackling debugging challenges in production systems. Why This Matters Your contributions will be instrumental in building scalable backend systems that power Parspec’s AI-driven platform. By delivering high-quality solutions and optimizing infrastructure, you will drive innovation in construction technology while enabling seamless user experiences for a rapidly growing market. Who You Are You are a skilled backend engineer with 3+ years of experience who thrives in fast-paced environments. You have a proven track record of leading technical projects while collaborating across teams to deliver impactful results. Minimum Qualifications Proficiency in backend software development using Python, Golang, or similar object-oriented languages. Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, service-oriented architecture (SOA), and microservice architectures. Hands-on experience with MySQL databases (schema design and query optimization). Experience deploying and managing services on AWS/GCP platforms. Familiarity with containerization tools like Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Skilled in performance optimization and debugging within distributed systems. Proven ability to lead technical projects and mentor junior team members effectively. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to AI/ML pipelines and Elasticsearch integration. Experience serving ML/LLM models in production using inference frameworks such as NVIDIA Triton, vLLM, TorchServe, or ONNX Runtime, including request batching, autoscaling, and latency/throughput tuning. Working knowledge of GPU hardware (eg. NVIDIA T4, L4, A10G, A100/H100): How memory, compute, and precision (FP16/INT8) trade off against cost per inference, and familiarity with optimizations like tensorRT, quantization, and GPU utilisation monitoring. What We Offer Competitive salary and benefits, including family insurance coverage, free health teleconsultations, and learning/upskilling budgets Equity in the company Flexible hours and a hybrid work setup Unlimited PTO Opportunity to grow with a fast-scaling company transforming a large market Preferred Location: Bellandur, Bengaluru, with regular in-office presence Join Us At Parspec, we recognize that traditional job descriptions don’t always capture the full range of your unique abilities-and that’s perfectly okay. You may not meet every requirement, but if you bring a mix of experiences, fresh perspectives, and a passion that aligns with our mission, we want to hear from you! The Parspec team believes that varied backgrounds drive better outcomes and fuel innovation. We are a team of self-starters that lead from every seat. We think big, set a standard of excellence and are committed to diversity and a discrimination-free workplace. We welcome applicants from all walks of life to join us and help shape the future at Parspec. How to Apply Submit your application and resume highlighting your achievements. Apply now and help drive transformative change in one of the world’s oldest and largest industries!
